title: Sparkly present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff8b0'>

    <circle cx='88' cy='72' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='16' cy='80' r='2.2'/>

  </g>

  <!-- box body -->
  <rect x='20' y='50' width='60' height='42' rx='3' fill='url(#boxg)'/>
  <!-- box lid -->
  <rect x='16' y='40' width='68' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ff7d8c'/>
  <rect x='16' y='50' width='68' height='4' fill='#c41f3c'/>

  <rect x='44' y='40' width='12' height='52' fill='url(#ribg)'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='5' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='38.5' r='2' fill='#fff6c0'/>
</svg>
